mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE MoM > 0.5% and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST MoM < -10% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a strengthening supply side of the economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM > 1% and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 month-over-month signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS MoM > 200,000 and 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS MoM < -1% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 2% year-over-year, the combination signals tightening monetary conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances.
